1	import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi, afterEach } from 'vitest'
2	import { RateLimiter } from '../src/rate-limiter'
3	
4	describe('RateLimiter', () => {
5	  beforeEach(() => {
6	    vi.useFakeTimers()
7	    vi.setSystemTime(0)
8	  })
9	
10	  afterEach(() => {
11	    vi.useRealTimers()
12	  })
13	
14	  it('allows the first request', () => {
15	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
16	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
17	  })
18	
19	  it('fixed mode: allows up to max in a window then denies', () => {
20	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
21	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
22	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
23	    }
24	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
25	  })
26	
27	  it('fixed mode: capacity resets after the window ends', () => {
28	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 2, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
29	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
30	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
31	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
32	    vi.setSystemTime(1000)
33	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
34	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
35	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
36	  })
37	
38	  it('tracks keys independently', () => {
39	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 2, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
40	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
41	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
42	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
43	    expect(limiter.allow('user-2')).toBe(true)
44	    expect(limiter.allow('user-2')).toBe(true)
45	    expect(limiter.allow('user-2')).toBe(false)
46	  })
47	
48	  it('sliding mode: denies the 6th call within the trailing window', () => {
49	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding' })
50	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
51	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
52	    }
53	    vi.setSystemTime(500)
54	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
55	  })
56	
57	  it('sliding mode: denies across fixed-window boundary while calls are still in trailing window', () => {
58	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding' })
59	    vi.setSystemTime(950)
60	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
61	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
62	    }
63	    vi.setSystemTime(1100)
64	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
65	  })
66	
67	  it('sliding mode: allows after oldest call ages out', () => {
68	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding' })
69	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
70	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
71	    }
72	    vi.setSystemTime(1100)
73	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
74	  })
75	
76	  it('sliding mode: tracks keys independently', () => {
77	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 2, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding' })
78	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
79	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
80	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
81	    expect(limiter.allow('user-2')).toBe(true)
82	    expect(limiter.allow('user-2')).toBe(true)
83	    expect(limiter.allow('user-2')).toBe(false)
84	  })
85	})
